618-1916-6495.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
618-1916-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

240-574-969-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-969-5470.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

2023-4770-6723-6791.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4474-5457--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4474-5457--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Selvala triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3286-4687-5115.notablePrerequisites: Gemstone Array has at least four counters on it.
3286-4687-5115.description:
Activate Inga and Esika by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Gemstone Array, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

856-5631-5776-8095.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

222-527-728-7175.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

728-4488-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2921-5708.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1003-1778-4973-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1003-1778-4973-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1580-3220-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2092-2800-4954.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Mirari's Wake triggers, adding {1}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping the land and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.
2092-2800-4954.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

4529-5256-5659-5929.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Bontu.
When God-Eternal Bontu dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Bontu's power, which will cause you to mill God-Eternal Bontu.
As God-Eternal Bontu is a Lhurgoyf due to Leyline of Transformation, Disa's first ability triggers, returning God-Eternal Bontu from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

5686-6871-6879-7223.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 4.

2440-3480-6737-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Barret's triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token.
When the Rebel enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Rebel you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Rebel token.
Activate the Rebel by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-3480-6737-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Rebel.

1020-2866-4659-6556.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Temur Battlecrier.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat.

560-1563-2457-7060.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

413-6701--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-6701--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a persist creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other persist creature.
Resolve the perist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

970-1656-3260-5796.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
970-1656-3260-5796.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Asmodeus's first ability by paying {B/P}{B/P}{B/P}, causing you to draw seven cards.
Starving Revenant triggers seven times, causing you to gain 7 life and target opponent to lose 7 life.
Repeat.

1247-3814-5536.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two mana-producing lands.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Argothian Elder and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-3814-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Argothian Elder's ability by tapping it, untapping two lands.
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2034-2324-3097-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Proper Burial triggers, causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

654-1170-2397-4124-5954.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

165-1069-4885-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
You have at least one experience counter.
165-1069-4885-5499.description:
Activate Daxos the Returned by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a */* Spirit creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Spirit.
Activate the Spirit by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4918-5658.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Satya or Lightning Runner.
You have at least six {E}.
4918-5658.description:
Declare Lightning Runner and Satya as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Satya trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and create a token copy of Lighting Runner that's tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and then pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare Satya and each Lightning Runner you control as attackers.
Resolve the Satya trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and create a token copy of Lighting Runner that's tapped and attacking.
Resolve the first Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and choosing not to pay.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Lightning Runner trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and then pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 4.

2152-4447-4691.description:
At the beginning of an opponent's upkeep, Assault Suit triggers, giving them control of Vilis.
During that player's next draw step, they draw a card.
Fate Unraveler triggers, dealing 1 damage to that opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 until the opponent loses the game either due to drawing from an empty library or by having a life total of 0.
When the opponent loses the game, you regain control of Vilis.
Repeat from step 1 for each remaining opponent.

3410-3652-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding {U/B}.
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary and Kels trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Ornithopter on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Kels trigger, causing you to pay {U/B} to draw Ornithopter from the top of your library.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat.

654-1284-1978-2688-5077.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Scaretiller.
Scaretiller does not have summoning sickness.
654-1284-1978-2688-5077.description:
Activate Crystal Vein's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Crystal Vein from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Crystal Vein enters the battlefield tapped, triggering Amulet of Vigor, untapping Crystal Vein.
Resolve the Scaretiller ability from step 2, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Scaretiller.
Repeat.

126-1173-2056-3198-3395.description:
Cast Final Fortune, creating a Servo token with Saheeli.
Mutate Lore Drakkis onto the Servo token, returning Final Fortune from your graveyard to your hand.
Pay {U} and tap Crystal Shard to return Lore Drakkis to your hand.
Pass the turn.
When the lose the game trigger is on the stack, tap Obeka to end the turn.
Repeat.

4654-4944.description:
Activate Hyalopterous Lemure's ability.
Crackdown Construct gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
